dz: 皇帝马库斯·奥雷利乌斯授予他的儿子科莫多斯"伊姆佩拉特"(Imperator)军衔,并让他出任罗马军团的最高指挥官.
de: Emperor Marcus Aurelius grants his son Commodus the rank of "Imperator" and makes him Supreme Commander of the Roman legions.
